# The Provider System

> Websites, lead CRMs, follow-up systems, and custom operating tools for blue-collar businesses.

The Provider System is owned by John W Johnson. The company builds practical digital systems for contractors, trades, local service companies, and selected operators who need more than a brochure website. The core promise is simple: help business owners get found, capture leads, follow up faster, and keep ownership of the website or system that runs the work.

## Primary Positioning

The Provider System is focused on blue-collar and local service businesses first. Ideal clients include plumbers, electricians, HVAC companies, roofers, general contractors, landscapers, painters, pest control companies, towing companies, auto detailers, junk removal companies, pressure washing companies, garage door companies, window cleaners, and similar trade businesses.

The company also accepts selected custom system builds when the scope is operationally meaningful, such as CRMs, dashboards, intake portals, booking tools, quote workflows, and internal operating systems.

## Core Offers

### Website Foundation
- Route: /websites
- Best for: blue-collar businesses that need a credible, fast, conversion-focused website.
- Typical starting point: $2,500+ or managed monthly plans from $299/month.
- Includes: service pages, mobile-first design, click-to-call actions, contact/quote forms, local search foundations, Google Business Profile support, trust sections, ownership-minded setup, and hosting/deployment configuration.

### Lead & CRM System
- Route: /lead-crm-system
- Best for: businesses losing leads through scattered forms, phone calls, spreadsheets, inboxes, or missed follow-up.
- Typical starting point: $6,500+ or managed monthly plans from $750/month.
- Includes: lead capture, CRM pipeline, status tracking, internal notifications, follow-up workflows, quote/request forms, booking or scheduling support when needed, dashboard views, and owner handoff.

### Custom Operating System
- Route: /custom-systems
- Best for: operators who need a custom app, client portal, internal dashboard, workflow system, or purpose-built software tool.
- Typical starting point: custom quote after audit, often $12k+ depending on scope.
- Includes: discovery, architecture, app design, database planning, dashboard/admin views, workflow logic, deployment, and handoff.

## Redirect Policy

Older broad-positioning routes now redirect into the focused structure:

- /services and /services/* redirect to /lead-crm-system, except website and custom SaaS pages.
- /services/website-development redirects to /websites.
- /services/custom-saas-development redirects to /custom-systems.
- /industries and /industries/* redirect to /blue-collar.
- /use-cases and /use-cases/* redirect to /lead-crm-system.
- /platforms and /platforms/* redirect to /custom-systems.
- /guides and /guides/* redirect to /blog.
